title: @The Second City is now in NYC and I got to check it. what a fun nigh...
transcript: Join me at the theater tonight. I'm seeing a sketch comedy show at The Second City. The Second City is a comedy institution with numerous famous alumni like Stephen Colbert, Tina Fey, Jackie Hoffman. Started in Chicago. I have always wanted to go, but I've never made it to a show. I was thrilled when they announced that they were opening up a venue right here in New York City that would have two theaters with, also classes and events. And then they invited me to come check it out. My friend Sam and I picked the seven PM Friday show, Ruthless Acts of kindness, which is one of the first shows they are doing today. We sat right in the front row, which at first I was very nervous about, but ended up being perfect. We ordered great cocktails, and they had some good food. I ordered French fries and expecting, like, I don't know, frozen fries, but no, these were, like, gourmet. I'm a big French fry person, so. And the show was so funny. It was a mix of sketch comedy and improv, and it was so relevant. Like, they're making pop culture jokes of, like, things that happened in the last 24 hours. This cast was phenomenal. It was like SNL, but, like, I'm so glad I got to be here. It was the perfect way to spend an evening. It would be a really good group activity. And also, I kind of want to take An improv class now
showTitle: The Second City - Ruthless Acts of Kindness
